decisionPass.classification: A model configuration write ownership, C test handshake publication
decisionPass.revision: ADR131 NR-04 model configuration writer ownership registered and pushed before source. Config file facts only; no permission, Evidence or Context authority change.

normalAndRecovery: Real Desktop public CRUD and Rust Store concurrently perform 20 channel/model creations and 30 independent counter updates in one isolated v2 file. Unknown root and all updates preserved; both languages compute the same raw-file and identity revision.

Node and Rust reject stale snapshot commits, corruption, explicit future versions and bounds without overwriting the original. Missing alone yields empty; Node legacy adapters retain layouts/unknown fields.

Common canonical-directory mkdir lock encloses full synchronous read/mutate/write, including Desktop read-time migration and runtime-node explicit OAuth metadata. Nested ownership stays in one process; replaced owners and unknown lock bodies remain untouched.
Actual delayed Desktop model diagnostic releases lock during HTTP, then skips stale writeback after another Store changes configuration. Pricing backfill re-reads under lock after network.

0600 temporary file, file fsync, atomic rename and directory fsync. Injected real directory-sync failure after credential and config commit retains actual Vault/config state and reports unknown; no rollback to older credentials.

The Node lock handles an owner releasing between mkdir EEXIST and lstat within the original deadline. Rust fixture completion marker is atomically published so cancellation assertions wait for a complete JSON handshake.

preservedFailures.observed: Actual prior Desktop addProvider accepted corrupt JSON as empty and discarded an unknown root field. Both regression tests failed before repair.
Actual Rust/Desktop contention hit ENOENT after mkdir EEXIST and before lock lstat. Fixed bounded recompetition, no timeout increase or assertion removal.
89/90 Episode tests passed; MCP cancellation test read an empty newly created last-request JSON. Failed owned root .tmpLj2iHy preserved; writer source used truncate/write rather than atomic publish.
preservedFailures.repair: Test-only helper marker publishes complete bytes via rename; unchanged get/action/cancel=4/no-MCP and killed/reaped assertions passed focused and full native rerun. Failed fixture child PID43453 confirmed absent; no unrelated process signaled.

preservedFailures.observed: Directory-sync injection initially fired on a preceding read-time subscription migration. Fixture now arms only after actual new credential write; both token and config reconciliation assertions remain.
Inferred JS exception helper returned void, widening decoded content to undefined. Declared never return rather than weakening the TS serializer input.
Initial test marker PathBuf shadowed request DTO and failed compilation. Renamed marker variable; focused and final full clippy/test pass.
